segments.say: Chess rule number eight. Black is up two whole rooks. Can White still save the game?
segments.caption: Down two rooks. Saved?

segments.say: Yes! Queen e8 check, queen h5 check, again and again. The king can never escape.
When the same position appears three times, it's a draw by repetition.
Did you know this? More rules are coming. Subscribe so you don't miss them.
